```{r explainability-lime-and-summary-tables, eval = TRUE, include = TRUE, echo = FALSE}
# ---- LIME ----

require(lime)

required <- c("expl_fns", "lime_df", "bg_main", "train", "feats", "stability_metrics",
              "faithfulness", "shap_faith_summary", "stab_axis2")
missing_objs <- required[!sapply(required, exists)]
if (length(missing_objs) > 0) {
  stop("Missing from the session: ", paste(missing_objs, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
}

LIME_MODELS  <- c("GLM", "GBM_selected", "ANN_selected")
N_PERM       <- if (PILOT) 1000 else 5000   # perturbed samples per explanation
R_LIME       <- if (PILOT) 3 else 10        # repeated explanations (explainer noise)
N_LIME_TRAIN <- 5000                        # training rows the explainers learn distributions from
LIME_SEED    <- 2030

# 1. Bins defined once from the training data and saved before computing explanations
edges_from_bins <- function(x, bin) unname(sort(tapply(x, factor(bin), min))[-1])
bm <- train$BonusMalusLog
bm_above <- bm[bm > min(bm)]

bin_edges <- list(
  DrivAge       = edges_from_bins(train$DrivAge, train$DrivAgeBin),
  VehAge        = edges_from_bins(train$VehAge,  train$VehAgeBin),
  BonusMalusLog = c(min(bm_above), quantile(bm_above, c(1/3, 2/3), names = FALSE)),
  DensityLog    = quantile(train$DensityLog, c(.25, .5, .75), names = FALSE),
  VehPower      = quantile(train$VehPower,   c(.25, .5, .75), names = FALSE)
)
bin_edges <- lapply(bin_edges, function(e) sort(unique(e)))

cutters <- lapply(names(bin_edges), function(f) {
  e <- bin_edges[[f]]; lab <- paste0(f, "_b", seq_len(length(e) + 1))
  function(x) cut(x, c(-Inf, e, Inf), labels = lab, right = FALSE)
})
names(cutters) <- names(bin_edges)

reps <- lapply(names(cutters), function(f) {
  r <- tapply(train[[f]], cutters[[f]](train[[f]]), median)
  # representative raw value of each bin
  setNames(as.numeric(r), names(r)) 
})
names(reps) <- names(cutters)

bin_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(cutters), function(f) {
  e <- c(-Inf, bin_edges[[f]]); sh <- as.numeric(prop.table(table(cutters[[f]](train[[f]]))))
  data.frame(feature = f, bin = names(reps[[f]]), lower_edge = e,
             share_of_train = round(sh, 3), representative = reps[[f]], row.names = NULL)
}))
cat("Option C bins (review before continuing):\n"); print(bin_table)
saveRDS(list(edges = bin_edges, reps = reps, table = bin_table, created_at = Sys.time()),
        paste0("lime_bins_option_C", RUN_TAG, ".rds"))

# 2. The 3 lime spaces: How a policy is captured into LIME, 
# and how LIME output is mapped back into the model
z_mu <- colMeans(train[continuous_features])
z_sd <- sapply(train[continuous_features], sd)
spaces <- list(
  C = list(to = function(df) { 
    for (f in names(cutters)) 
      df[[f]] <- cutters[[f]](df[[f]]); df 
    },
    from = function(df) { 
      for (f in names(cutters))
        df[[f]] <- as.numeric(reps[[f]][as.character(df[[f]])]); df }),
  A = list(to = function(df) df, from = function(df) df),
  D = list(to = function(df) { for (f in continuous_features)
             df[[f]] <- (df[[f]] - z_mu[[f]]) / z_sd[[f]]; df },
           from = function(df) { for (f in continuous_features)
             df[[f]] <- df[[f]] * z_sd[[f]] + z_mu[[f]]; df })
)

# lime needs a model class with two methods
model_type.lograte_model    <- function(x, ...) "regression"
predict_model.lograte_model <- function(x, newdata, type, ...) {
  data.frame(Response = x$predict(as.data.frame(newdata)))
}
registerS3method("model_type",    "lograte_model", model_type.lograte_model,    envir = asNamespace("lime"))
registerS3method("predict_model", "lograte_model", predict_model.lograte_model, envir = asNamespace("lime"))

make_lime_model <- function(model_name, scheme) {
  structure(list(predict = function(d) expl_fns[[model_name]](spaces[[scheme]]$from(d))),
            class = "lograte_model")
}

set.seed(LIME_SEED)
lime_train_raw <- train[sample.int(nrow(train), N_LIME_TRAIN), feats]
make_explainer <- function(scheme, mdl) {
  tr <- spaces[[scheme]]$to(lime_train_raw)
  switch(scheme,
         # features are already binned factors
         C = lime::lime(tr, mdl, bin_continuous = FALSE),   
         A = lime::lime(tr, mdl, bin_continuous = TRUE, n_bins = 4, quantile_bins = TRUE),
         D = lime::lime(tr, mdl, bin_continuous = FALSE))
}

lime_weights <- function(expl, x_sp, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  out <- lime::explain(x_sp, expl, n_features = length(feats), n_permutations = N_PERM,
                       feature_select = "none")
  w <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow(x_sp), length(feats), dimnames = list(NULL, feats))
  w[cbind(match(as.character(out$case), rownames(x_sp)), match(out$feature, feats))] <-
    out$feature_weight
  r2 <- tapply(out$model_r2, out$case, mean)[rownames(x_sp)]
  list(w = w, r2 = as.numeric(r2))
}

# 3. Run LIME, Fidelity, and Stability
lime_rows <- list(); lime_w1 <- list()
for (scheme in c("C", "A", "D")) {
  for (m in LIME_MODELS) {
    cat(sprintf("LIME scheme %s, model %s\n", scheme, m))
    ex <- tryCatch(make_explainer(scheme, make_lime_model(m, scheme)),
                   error = function(e) { 
                     message("  explainer failed: ",
                             conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
    if (is.null(ex)) next
    x_sp <- spaces[[scheme]]$to(lime_df); 
    rownames(x_sp) <- as.character(seq_len(nrow(x_sp)))
    runs <- tryCatch(lapply(seq_len(R_LIME), 
                            function(r) lime_weights(ex, x_sp, LIME_SEED + r)),
                     error = function(e) { message("  explain failed: ",
                                                   conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
    if (is.null(runs)) next

    faith_cor <- NA_real_
    # attributions are comparable to feature removal only for binned schemes
    if (scheme %in% c("C", "A")) {   
      pf <- function(d) expl_fns[[m]](spaces[[scheme]]$from(d))
      fc <- faithfulness(pf, x_sp, spaces[[scheme]]$to(bg_main), runs[[1]]$w)
      faith_cor <- mean(fc$cor, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
    st <- stability_metrics(lapply(runs, `[[`, "w"))
    lime_rows[[paste(scheme, m)]] <- cbind(scheme = scheme, model = m,
                                           lime_r2 = mean(sapply(runs, function(r) 
                                             mean(r$r2, na.rm = TRUE))),
                                           lime_faith_cor = faith_cor, st)
    lime_w1[[paste(scheme, m)]] <- runs[[1]]$w
  }
}
lime_summary <- do.call(rbind, lime_rows); 
rownames(lime_summary) <- NULL
cat("\nLIME summary (explainer-noise stability; 
    D weights are per standard deviation):\n")
print(lime_summary[, c("scheme", "model", "lime_r2", "lime_faith_cor", 
                       "global_rank_cor", "top3_overlap", "local_rank_cor", 
                       "rel_sd", "sign_agreement")], digits = 3)

# Do conclusions survive a change of binning? (rows = scheme, columns = model)
cat("\nLocal rank correlation by scheme and model:\n")
print(round(with(lime_summary, tapply(local_rank_cor, list(scheme, model), identity)), 3))
cat("\nLIME surrogate R2 by scheme and model:\n")
print(round(with(lime_summary, tapply(lime_r2, list(scheme, model), identity)), 3))

# 4. Summaries

res_file <- "final_evaluation_results.rds"
if (file.exists(res_file)) {
  ev   <- readRDS(res_file)
  perf <- ev$metrics[ev$metrics$set == "test", c("model", "deviance", "gini")]
  cx   <- ev$complexity[, c("model", "measure", "value")]
  primary_lime <- lime_summary[lime_summary$scheme == "C", 
                               c("model", "lime_r2", "lime_faith_cor")]
  rq1 <- Reduce(function(a, b) merge(a, b, by = "model", all.x = TRUE),
                list(perf, cx, shap_faith_summary[, c("model", "faith_cor", 
                                                      "faith_rmse")], primary_lime))
  rq1 <- rq1[match(names(expl_fns), rq1$model), ]
  rownames(rq1) <- NULL
  cat("\nRQ1: performance and explanation fidelity (LIME columns use option C):\n")
  print(rq1, digits = 4)

  op <- par(mar = c(4.5, 4.5, 1, 1))
  plot(rq1$deviance, 
       rq1$faith_cor, 
       pch = 19, 
       xlab = "Test deviance (lower is better)",
       ylab = "SHAP faithfulness (correlation)", 
       xlim = rev(range(rq1$deviance)) )
  text(rq1$deviance, rq1$faith_cor, rq1$model, pos = 3, cex = 0.8)
  par(op)
} else {
  rq1 <- NULL
  warning(res_file, " not found in ", 
          getwd(), ": RQ1 table skipped.")
}

cat("\nRQ3: SHAP stability under data resampling (axis 2):\n"); 
print(stab_axis2, digits = 3)

saveRDS(list(lime_summary = lime_summary, lime_weights_first_run = lime_w1,
             bin_table = bin_table, rq1 = rq1, rq3 = stab_axis2,
             settings = list(N_PERM = N_PERM, R_LIME = R_LIME, LIME_MODELS = LIME_MODELS,
                             LIME_SEED = LIME_SEED),
             created_at = Sys.time()),
        paste0("explain_lime_and_summary", RUN_TAG, ".rds"))
```
